commands_or_harness: setup: security -i (stdin) create-keychain in temp dir; security set-keychain-settings (no auto-lock); security -i (stdin) add-generic-password with a random canary
setup: HOME=<tmp> /usr/bin/ssh-agent -U -a <tmp>/agent.sock; ssh-keygen -t ed25519; ssh-add -t 14400 <key>; rm <private key file>

per sample: ssh-add -T <pub>; ssh-keygen -Y sign -f <pub> via the dedicated agent, then -Y check-novalidate; security find-generic-password -w <tmp keychain> (compared in-process, never printed); ioreg IOConsoleLocked and CGSSessionScreenIsLocked only
fresh SSH login sampling not enabled (no --fixture-runtime)
cleanup: kill exact dedicated agent PID (comm+lstart re-checked); security delete-keychain <tmp keychain>; compare user search list and default keychain digests; rm -rf <tmp>

observed_result.criterion: Smoke (harness check, screen unlocked, no lock): the dedicated agent signs and the disposable keychain item reads in every sample; with --fixture-runtime also a fresh SSH login to ca1 succeeds in every sample while the ca2 principal-mismatch and ca1 no-agent controls are refused. Validity: completed without interruption or setup failure, cleanup complete, no canary in artifacts.
observed_result.summary: INTERRUPTED before completion. Smoke run, screen unlocked, no lock exercised: dedicated agent signing=available_all_samples; disposable keychain read=available_all_samples; fresh SSH login=not_measured; 5 samples; cleanup_complete=true; canary_scan=clean.

limitations: Measures a dedicated, script-started OpenSSH ssh-agent and a disposable file-based custom keychain only. Says nothing about the login keychain, the data-protection keychain, Secure Enclave/CTK keys, 1Password, or a launchd-supervised Heimdall signer.
Screen lock only. Logout, sleep, reboot and headless operation are separate probes (docs/research/g04-managed-credentials.md).
ioreg IOConsoleLocked / CGSSessionScreenIsLocked are undocumented IORegistry properties used only as corroboration; owner attestation is recorded separately.
The disposable keychain has auto-lock disabled (no timeout, no lock-on-sleep), so any lock observed is attributable to OS behavior at screen lock, not to keychain settings.
On macOS 26.4+ a keychain file may reference a protected entropy file in /var/db/SystemKeys (Apple TN3137); whether delete-keychain removes it cannot be inspected without disabling SIP.

Status verified means the measurement is valid (lock window established, cleanup complete, no canary in artifacts). Availability itself is reported in observed_result.outcomes_in_window and may be negative.
